content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 10.5 gives us our preferred New York governing law, but the Agreement designates no forum at all — no venue, jurisdiction, or arbitration provision exists anywhere in the document. That leaves the preferred position's exclusive-jurisdiction element unmet (and the fallback inapplicable, since the law is New York rather than Delaware/California/England and Wales). The redline adds one short venue sentence after Section 10.5 fixing exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts in New York County over the merits, with the customary temporary injunctive relief carve-out, and leaves the governing law sentence verbatim.
